title: Half-Life and Radioactive Decay
learningObjectives: Define half-life as the time for one half of the atoms of a radioactive substance to disintegrate into another nuclear form.
Compare measured half-lives ranging from millionths of a second to billions of years.

evidence.quote: The time in which one half of the atoms of a particular radioactive substance disintegrate into another nuclear form.

explanations.text: Half-life is the time needed for one half of the atoms of a radioactive substance to disintegrate into another nuclear form.

evidence.quote: Measured half-lives vary from millionths of a second to billions of years.

explanations.text: Measured half-lives vary widely, from millionths of a second to billions of years.

evidence.quote: Also called physical or radiological half-life.

explanations.text: The same interval is also called physical or radiological half-life.
